items.title: Elon Musk says 'AI and robots' are the only way to solve America's debt burden
items.summary: Elon Musk estimated that "digital superintelligence" could boost the global output of goods and services by 20% to 30%.
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，“人工智能和机器人”是解决美国债务负担的唯一途径
items.summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克估计，“数字超级智能”可以将全球商品和服务产出提高20%至30%。

items.title: If Elon Musk gifts SpaceX stock through Trump Accounts, it will come with a catch
items.summary: Elon Musk's planned SpaceX stock donation could come with strings attached if he uses Trump Accounts. New Treasury rules limit when children can sell shares.
items.titleZh: 如果埃隆·马斯克通过特朗普账户赠送SpaceX股票，那将是一个陷阱
items.summaryZh: 如果埃隆·马斯克使用特朗普账户，他计划捐赠的SpaceX股票可能会附带条件。新的财政部规定限制了儿童出售股票的时间。

items.title: Elon Musk says money will be 'irrelevant' if his vision of a multiplanetary future comes true
items.summary: Elon Musk says "money becomes irrelevant" in a multiplanetary economy, and nearly all of his fortune will be taxed away within a few generations.
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，如果他对多平面未来的愿景成真，金钱将“无关紧要”
items.summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，在多平台经济中，“金钱变得无关紧要”，他几乎所有的财富都将在几代人内被征税。
